Frequently asked questions

Which regulations do these courses follow?
  • OSHA Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Awareness Training: in accordance with ANSI Standard Z390.1, Accepted Practices for Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Training Program.
  • OSHA Air Monitoring and Gas Detection Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.1000, 1910.120, 1910.146, 1926.65, 1926.1203, 1926.1204, and OSHA’s General Duty Clause.
  • OSHA Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Training (International): in accordance with ANSI Standard Z390.1, Accepted Practices for Hydrogen Sulfide (H₂S) Training Program.
  • Comprehensive Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Safety Training for the Oil & Gas Industry: in accordance with ANSI/ASSP Standard Z390.1-2024, Accepted Practices for Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Training Programs; and API RP 49 and 55, Recommended Practices.
  • Authorized Gas Tester Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.106, 1910.119, 1910.120, 1910.134, 1910.146, 1910.147, 1910.252, 1910.1000, 1910 Subpart Z, and OSHA’s General Duty Clause.
How long does Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) & Gas Detection Training take?
  • OSHA Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Awareness Training: 3 hours.
  • OSHA Air Monitoring and Gas Detection Training: 3 hours.
  • OSHA Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Training (International): 3 hours.
  • Comprehensive Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Safety Training for the Oil & Gas Industry: 4 hours.
  • Authorized Gas Tester Training: 8 hours.

Training is self-paced, so you can stop and pick up where you left off at any time.

How long do I have to finish?

You get a 3-month completion timeline, 1-year access to training materials.

Yes. You can download your certificate of completion as soon as you pass the final exam.

  • OSHA Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Awareness Training: valid 12 months
